issue.title: docs: add medicus to community section
issue.body:
Adds `medicus` to the community list.

Medicus is a health check library, not a hosted service. Its H3 handler (`medicus/h3`) runs custom checkers and responds with a JSON status. It works with H3 v1 and v2 and can be exported from a Nitro route file. MIT licensed, about 48k npm downloads a month.

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/medicus
- repo: https://github.com/arthurfiorette/medicus
- docs: https://medicus.js.org

I'm the author.
